answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 45 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a ledge bet on surviving 45 epochs of grading, and every pulse settlement recomputes the cipher schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 20 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
